Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Expleo is a global engineering, technology, and consulting service provider that partners with leading organizations to guide them through their business transformation, helping them achieve operational excellence and future-proof their businesses.
Expleo benefits from more than 50 years of experience developing complex products in automotive and aerospace, optimizing manufacturing processes, and ensuring the quality of information systems. Leveraging its deep sector knowledge and wide-ranging expertise in fields including AI engineering, digitalization, automation, cybersecurity and data science, the group’s mission is to fast-track innovation through each step of the value chain.
With a worldwide presence in 30 countries, our global footprint includes excellence centers around the world, including Romania since 1994.
 Responsibilities
 As a Junior Visual C++ Software Engineer, you will contribute to software models and simulation applications under the guidance of experienced engineers. This role is ideal for an early-career developer who wants to deepen their C++ skills while working with real-world vehicle systems, instruments, graphics, and user interfaces.
 Software modelling of various vehicle systems (aircraft, helicopters, combat vehicles, ships, etc.) 
 Analysis of the technical documentation for the vehicle system or component to be modelled; 
 Preparation of software design documentation for the developed model; 
 Implementation of the source code in accordance with the approved design; 
 Stand-alone testing and validation of the resulting software model. 
 Analysis of the technical documentation for the instrument or indicator to be modelled; 
 Preparation of software design documentation, including specifications for the development of the required graphical textures; 
 Implementation of the source code for indicator graphics rendering and communication with the host/driving application. 
 Development of software-based user interfaces using QT, NET (C#), MFC, or other relevant APIs, with integration capabilities within C++ based environments. 
 Development of specialized applications tailored to the requirements of the simulation industry. 
 Qualifications
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or another relevant technical field. 
 Minimum 1 year experience with C++ including Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and STL 
 Good understanding and practical implementation of mathematical algorithms. 
 Advanced English communication skills, both written and spoken. 
 Proficiency in MS Office package for technical and software design documentation. 
 Familiarity with SVN and Git, Jira and Confluence and Agile development practices. 
 Strong team-working and collaboration skills. 
 Desired Skills
 Exposure to simulation, embedded, 3D graphics (OpenGL, DirectX, Vulkan etc.) or vehicle-related software. 
 Experience with Object-Oriented Design (OOD), Qt, C#, MFC, or graphics-rendering APIs, Python or React for web-based applications and user interfaces. 
 Experience using AI tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot. 
 What Do I Need Before I Apply
 Availability to travel locally and internationally for various project assignments. 
 Role is hybrid 3 days per week in Magurele, Ilfov.
